Ly.bar_b_note: Only the Old Bram frame stages a speaker; Warder Solene shows the player alone in an empty courtyard and Keeper Hald's view is a third blocked by a blurred brown occluder, so the dialogue moments never read as authored scenes.

El.bar_b_note: Warm slope light and blue distance help, but the defeated grunt stands idle next to the player in the after frame and only the toast says he lost.

Ap.bar_b_note: A's bristled spotted-fur boar is near the naturalistic bar but barely clears the 1.80 m ruler and its gold rosettes are noisy; B's smooth terracotta-and-moss pig reads as a vinyl toy, is shorter than the trainer and its faint end tips onto its snout.

Pe.bar_b_note: Terrapup lies flat but is a small low-contrast tan blob, the Verdian faint still reads upright among foliage, and foreground grass covers the bottom half of every frame.

Rx.bar_b_note: The blue-grey panel, teal tab and gold headers are on-brief, but tiny grey rows, '(or F10)' and '[Q]/[Tab]' literals and a cut-off Fighting paragraph are PC-menu dense, not readable at a glance.

Gy.bar_b_note: The washed, semi-translucent tan ally fills the right half of all three frames and stands over the tiny trainers, so the fight has no readable staging next to Palworld's clear player/target framing.

Mg.bar_b_note: Standing Stormcapra matches the owner bar in fleece, horns and scale; A's faint end is crumpled but still reads as lying, while B's faint mid and faint end flatten the body into a fleece mat with horns stretched into detached black tubes.

Xc.bar_b_note: The elder has an appealing, clearly lit face, earthy green-brown palette and clean silhouette, but the big-eyed animated-film face is more cartoon than the naturalistic creatures and world around him.

Ue.bar_b_note: A's afters change the sites (banner torn down, cage opened with the captive standing, tent burnt to a smoke column), but the same emblem marker stone repeats at sites 3 and 5, and ground and wall textures are blurry; B often leaves the oxblood banner up, just deletes the cage at site 2, and has a hand or prop poking into the bottom-right of site 5.

Yr.bar_b_note: The aerial haze, cloud deck and blue horizon are close to Valheim-class distance, but the stiff straight-armed hang makes the carry read as a placeholder pose.

Mq.bar_b_note: The torchlit hall has a warm interior mood, but thick turquoise floor rails cut through the creatures, a blurred pillar blocks the warden_aldis-03 frame and the glowing orange ally looks unlit.

top_changes.change: Fix fight and dialogue camera framing: add collision pull-in so walls and pillars never fill a third of the frame (Ly Keeper Hald, Mq warden_aldis-03), cap the ally's share of the screen, and frame the speaker or opponent alongside the player (Ly, Gy, Mq).

Author grounded state poses: defeated-trainer kneel or slump (El), faint and rest poses that settle on the ground with intact horn skinning (Pe, Mg B), and a carried-by-the-shoulders flying grip (Yr).

Replace the turquoise arena rails with diegetic boundary dressing (rune stones, worn floor inlay) at low contrast, and give the settings screen larger high-contrast text with controller glyphs instead of literal key labels (Mq, Rx).
